title: AI × Chem 每日精选
subtitle: 预印本、方法、数据集与实验验证的每日精选。
method: 公开来源采集、历史去重、规则筛选与模型审阅
method_note: 系统保存当日公开元数据，与历史日报核验后排除已报道事件；论文新版本、新修订及不同软件发布等可核实更新仍可入选，随后由指定模型阅读全文摘要并完成精选。

items.title: A Dynamics-Informed Machine Learning Framework for Inhibitor Optimization Against Quickly Evolving Targets to Avoid Resistance
items.abstract_or_text: Drug resistance often emerges through mutations that reshape protein conformational ensembles, allowing inhibitor potency to be altered without directly disrupting protein-ligand contacts. Consequently, the molecular mechanisms underlying these effects remain difficult to identify, hindering the design of inhibitors with durable potency against rapidly evolving drug targets. To address this challenge, we developed ROBUST, a physics-informed machine learning framework that integrates experimental measurements, molecular dynamics simulations, and interpretable statistical modeling to identify energetic determinants of inhibitor potency. Using HIV-1 protease as a stringent model system for drug resistance, we determined 157 new inhibition constants and integrated them with prior measurements to establish a comprehensive experimental dataset of 364 protease-inhibitor pairs. Analysis of the corresponding molecular dynamics simulations revealed a compact network of energetic interactions that quantitatively explains how resistance mutations and inhibitor modifications jointly reshape molecular recognition and inhibitor potency across the multidimensional resistance landscape. Models constructed from these energetic signatures predicted binding free energies with high accuracy (RMSE < 1 kcal mol-1) and successfully generalized to unseen darunavir analogs. Importantly, ROBUST accurately prioritized unseen analogs based on their potency across the variant set, demonstrating its utility for identifying compounds with improved resistance profiles. Together, these results uncover the energetic principles through which resistance mutations and inhibitor modifications alter potency and establish ROBUST as a mechanistically interpretable framework for translating these insights into resistance-aware inhibitor optimization against rapidly evolving drug targets.
items.summary_zh: ROBUST 将实验抑制常数、分子动力学模拟和可解释统计模型结合，用于分析 HIV-1 protease 耐药突变与抑制剂改造如何共同影响结合能，并优先筛选具有耐药谱优势的 darunavir 类似物。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 以157个新测定值和364对 protease–inhibitor 数据为基础，模型在未见类似物上的结合自由能预测 RMSE < 1 kcal mol-1，兼具机制解释和实验支撑。局限是主要验证集中于 HIV-1 protease，跨靶点和更广泛化学空间的泛化仍需检验。
items.abstract_zh: 耐药性常通过突变重塑蛋白构象集合而产生，即使不直接破坏蛋白质与配体的接触，也能改变抑制剂效力。因此，阐明这些效应背后的分子机制仍然困难，阻碍了对快速演化靶点设计具有持久效力的抑制剂。为应对这一挑战，我们开发了 ROBUST，这是一种物理信息机器学习框架，整合实验测量、分子动力学模拟和可解释统计建模，以识别决定抑制剂效力的能量因素。我们以 HIV-1 protease 这一严格的耐药性模型系统为对象，测定了157个新的抑制常数，并将其与既有测量结果整合，建立了包含364对 protease-inhibitor 的综合实验数据集。对相应分子动力学模拟的分析揭示了一个紧凑的能量相互作用网络，该网络定量解释了耐药突变和抑制剂改造如何在多维耐药性景观中共同重塑分子识别与抑制剂效力。基于这些能量特征构建的模型以高准确度预测结合自由能（RMSE < 1 kcal mol-1），并成功泛化到未见过的 darunavir 类似物。重要的是，ROBUST 能根据化合物在不同变体集合中的效力准确优先排序未见类似物，显示出其识别耐药谱更优化合物的实用性。总之，本研究揭示了耐药突变和抑制剂改造改变效力的能量学原理，并建立了一个机制可解释的框架，将这些认识转化为针对快速演化靶点的耐药性知情抑制剂优化。
items.author_line: Intravaia, L. E., Kaur, J., Shaqra, A. M., Henes, M., Kosovrasti, K., Schroeder, V., Nalivaika, E. A., Ali, A., Kurt Yilmaz, N., Schiffer, C. A.

items.title: Higher-Order Molecular Grammars for Generative and Foundation Models in Chemistry
items.abstract_or_text: Molecular learning models are strongly shaped by their underlying representations. Yet standard sequential and graph formalisms struggle to explicitly encode higher-order topology, such as ring systems and recurring motifs. Existing higher-order representations can capture these structures directly, but they are often computationally demanding and difficult to decode into valid molecules. Here, we introduce Higher-order Grammar Representation (HGR), a principled, topology-aware framework that lifts molecules to combinatorial complexes and parses each complex into a compact sequence of production rules under a context-free higher-order grammar. By serialising higher-order topology into rule sequences, HGR makes these structures directly compatible with standard sequence models, avoiding the computational overhead of explicit higher-order encodings while preserving topological expressiveness. To reduce benchmark bias towards simple ring systems, we construct RingDiv, a ring-enriched benchmark containing 1.18 million molecules, including the curated RingDiv300k subset, and introduce the ring diversity index (RDI) to quantify ring-system coverage. In molecular generation, HGR-based models uniquely combine 100% validity by construction with leading distributional alignment, ranking first in FCD on all five generation benchmarks. In representation learning, HGR-FM achieves the highest mean AUC across seven MoleculeNet benchmarks under both transfer protocols, improving on the strongest baseline by 8.3 and 3.3 AUC points under probing and full fine-tuning, respectively. Collectively, these results establish HGR as an efficient higher-order representation for molecular generation and transferable representation learning.
items.summary_zh: HGR 将分子提升为组合复形，并用高阶上下文无关文法解析为规则序列，以显式表示环系和重复基元；作者同时构建 RingDiv 数据集和 RDI 指标。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在五个分子生成基准上实现构造性100%有效率并取得最佳 FCD，HGR-FM 在七个 MoleculeNet 任务上也提升了迁移性能。需注意结果主要来自预印本基准，真实设计任务中的化学可合成性尚未验证。
items.abstract_zh: 分子学习模型的表现很大程度上取决于其底层表示。然而，标准的序列形式和图形式难以显式编码高阶拓扑结构，例如环系和反复出现的基元。现有高阶表示可以直接捕捉这些结构，但通常计算开销大，且难以解码为有效分子。在此，我们提出 Higher-order Grammar Representation（HGR），一种具有明确原理、关注拓扑的框架：它将分子提升为组合复形，并在高阶上下文无关文法下将每个复形解析为紧凑的生成规则序列。通过将高阶拓扑序列化为规则序列，HGR 使这些结构可以直接兼容标准序列模型，在保留拓扑表达能力的同时避免显式高阶编码的计算开销。为减少基准对简单环系的偏向，我们构建了富含环系的 RingDiv 基准，其中包含一个经过筛选的 RingDiv300k 子集，共有1.18 million 个分子，并提出 ring diversity index（RDI）来量化环系覆盖范围。在分子生成方面，基于 HGR 的模型将构造性100%有效率与领先的分布对齐能力结合起来，在五个生成基准的 FCD 上均排名第一。在表示学习方面，HGR-FM 在七个 MoleculeNet 基准上、两种迁移协议下均取得最高平均 AUC；相较最强基线，在 probing 和 full fine-tuning 下分别提高8.3和3.3个 AUC 点。总体而言，这些结果表明 HGR 是一种高效的高阶表示，可用于分子生成和可迁移表示学习。
items.author_line: Yiming Huang, Yujie Zeng, Vijay Prakash Dwivedi, Simone Foti, Jianmin Wang, Jure Leskovec, Tolga Birdal

items.title: Automated Many-Body Simulations of Strongly Correlated Systems Using a Correlation-Aware Agentic Framework
items.abstract_or_text: We present CAFES, a correlation-aware agentic framework for electronic-structure simulations of strongly correlated systems. CAFES addresses two challenges: the fragmented software landscape for many-body calculations and the difficulty of selecting appropriate methods across diverse correlation regimes. It combines correlation diagnostics, adaptive method selection, and large language model (LLM) assistance for molecular, crystalline, and model-Hamiltonian systems. A study-task architecture separates study-level planning from task-level execution, while a curated scientific knowledge layer provides reusable guidance for method selection, workflow design, and result interpretation. We demonstrate CAFES through three research-level studies: calculating the low-lying electronic states of lutein using DMRG-CASSCF, probing phase competition in the extended honeycomb Hubbard model using DMET, and generating a quantum-chemical dataset with CCSD labels. These calculations demonstrate the potential of agentic workflows for strongly correlated electronic-structure problems, a regime that has received limited attention in existing agentic computational frameworks.
items.summary_zh: CAFES 用相关性诊断、自适应方法选择和 LLM 辅助，自动编排强关联体系的多体电子结构计算，并在 lutein、扩展 honeycomb Hubbard 模型和 CCSD 数据集上展示工作流。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把方法选择、任务规划和结果解释纳入同一可复用框架，覆盖分子、晶体和模型哈密顿量。当前证据是三个研究级案例，尚不足以证明在更广泛体系上稳定优于专家工作流。
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出 CAFES，一种面向强关联体系电子结构模拟、具有相关性感知能力的智能体框架。CAFES 针对两个挑战：多体计算软件生态分散，以及难以在不同关联区间选择合适方法。它结合相关性诊断、自适应方法选择和大型语言模型（LLM）辅助，适用于分子、晶体和模型哈密顿量体系。研究任务架构将研究级规划与任务级执行分离；经过整理的科学知识层则提供可复用的方法选择、工作流设计和结果解释指导。我们通过三个研究级案例展示 CAFES：使用 DMRG-CASSCF 计算 lutein 的低能电子态；使用 DMET 探究扩展 honeycomb Hubbard 模型中的相竞争；以及生成带有 CCSD 标签的量子化学数据集。这些计算展示了智能体工作流处理强关联电子结构问题的潜力，而这一领域在现有智能体计算框架中受到的关注仍然有限。

items.title: EP-Flow: Disordered Crystal Structure Prediction without Site-Level Annotations
items.abstract_or_text: Generative models have made rapid progress in ordered crystal structure prediction, yet many functional materials are intrinsically disordered, with substitutional mixing, vacancies, or interstitial species controlling their properties. Existing crystal generators either assume deterministic site occupations or require site-level disorder annotations, which are often unavailable when the chemical formula is the primary input. We formulate disordered crystal structure prediction through an Occupancy Distribution Matrix (ODM), a continuous site-by-species representation that unifies ordered crystals, solid solutions, vacancy disorder, and interstitial occupancy. A valid ODM must satisfy coupled site-wise occupancy, mass-conservation, and non-negativity constraints, placing each sample on a formula-dependent transportation polytope. We propose Entropic Polytope Flow (EP-Flow), a marginal-constrained flow matching framework that canonicalizes heterogeneous polytopes into a shared double-centered space, learns a marginal-preserving flow, and recovers feasible occupancies through a Sinkhorn inverse map. By jointly generating occupancies, fractional coordinates, and lattice parameters, EP-Flow achieves state-of-the-art performance on formula-conditioned disordered CSP benchmarks derived from COD and MPDS, substantially outperforming adapted ordered-crystal generators. Analyses further show that EP-Flow recovers sparse and chemically meaningful local disorder patterns rather than merely matching global composition statistics.
items.summary_zh: EP-Flow 用满足边际约束的流匹配模型，在无需位点级无序标注的情况下联合生成占位分布、分数坐标和晶格参数，预测含替位、空位或间隙原子的无序晶体。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把无序结构表示为满足质量守恒和非负性约束的 Occupancy Distribution Matrix，并在 COD、MPDS 衍生基准上超过改造后的有序晶体生成器。摘要未给出实验合成验证，化学合理性仍主要依赖计算基准。
items.abstract_zh: 生成模型在有序晶体结构预测方面进展迅速，但许多功能材料本质上是无序的，其性质由替位混合、空位或间隙物种控制。现有晶体生成器要么假定位点占据是确定的，要么需要位点级无序标注，而当化学式是主要输入时，这类标注往往不可获得。我们用 Occupancy Distribution Matrix（ODM）表述无序晶体结构预测；ODM 是一种连续的位点-物种表示，统一了有序晶体、固溶体、空位无序和间隙占据。有效 ODM 必须满足位点级占据、质量守恒和非负性等耦合约束，因此每个样本都位于由化学式决定的运输多面体上。我们提出 Entropic Polytope Flow（EP-Flow），一种边际约束流匹配框架：将异质多面体规范化到共享的双中心空间，学习保持边际的流，并通过 Sinkhorn 逆映射恢复可行占位。EP-Flow 联合生成占位、分数坐标和晶格参数，在源自 COD 和 MPDS 的、以化学式为条件的无序晶体结构预测基准上取得 state-of-the-art 性能，显著优于改造后的有序晶体生成器。进一步分析显示，EP-Flow 恢复的是稀疏且具有化学意义的局部无序模式，而不仅仅是匹配全局组成统计。
items.author_line: Qiuliang Liu, Liming Wu, Qi Li, Zhonglong Peng, Chang Chen, Xiaolong Chen, Wenbing Huang, Shifeng Jin

items.title: Generative modeling of intrinsically disordered protein regions by reinforcing sparse autoencoder features
items.abstract_or_text: Intrinsically disordered protein regions (IDRs) play central roles in cellular processes such as transcriptional regulation, signal transduction, and subcellular localization, yet their functional design remains challenging. Structure-based design methods do not readily apply to IDRs, and existing protein language models are trained on full-length protein sequences, thus learning a prior that is biased towards folded domains. Here, we present IDiom, an autoregressive protein language model trained on IDiom-DB, a dataset of 54 million predicted IDRs curated from the AlphaFold Database. IDiom generates diverse sequences that recapitulate the composition, patterning, motifs, and predicted disorder of natural IDRs. To control function-associated sequence patterns, we also introduce reinforcement learning with sparse autoencoder features (RL-SAE), a post-training method that rewards the generation of sequences that activate specified feature sets. Across eight IDR design tasks, RL-SAE sequences activate, on average, 90% of 30 targeted features, compared to 24% for activation steering. We demonstrate that RL-SAE improves the predicted subcellular localization and transcriptional activity of generated IDRs compared to steering and supervised fine-tuning, and enables features associated with distinct biological functions to be combined within individual sequences. Thus, IDiom and RL-SAE enable interpretable and composable IDR design through explicit control of function-associated sequence features. More broadly, RL-SAE could extend to other protein design settings where interpretable features provide useful design targets. Code is available at https://github.com/rotskoff-group/idiom.
items.summary_zh: IDiom 在 AlphaFold Database 中的5400万条预测 IDR 上训练，并用稀疏自编码器特征强化学习控制功能相关序列模式，实现可解释、可组合的 intrinsically disordered protein region 设计。
items.why_it_matters_zh: RL-SAE 在八项设计任务中平均激活30个目标特征中的90%，明显高于 activation steering 的24%，并改善预测的定位和转录活性。功能证据仍主要来自预测指标，尚缺乏系统湿实验验证。
items.abstract_zh: Intrinsically disordered protein regions（IDRs）在转录调控、信号转导和亚细胞定位等细胞过程中发挥核心作用，但其功能设计仍然具有挑战性。基于结构的设计方法并不容易应用于 IDR，而现有蛋白质语言模型在全长蛋白质序列上训练，因此学习到的先验偏向折叠结构域。在此，我们提出 IDiom，这是一个自回归蛋白质语言模型，在从 AlphaFold Database 整理出的包含54 million 条预测 IDR 的 IDiom-DB 数据集上训练。IDiom 生成的序列能够重现天然 IDR 的组成、模式、基序和预测无序性。为控制与功能相关的序列模式，我们还提出了基于稀疏自编码器特征的强化学习（RL-SAE）这一后训练方法，通过奖励生成能够激活指定特征集合的序列来实现控制。在八项 IDR 设计任务中，RL-SAE 序列平均激活30个目标特征中的90%，而 activation steering 仅为24%。我们证明，与 steering 和 supervised fine-tuning 相比，RL-SAE 能改善所生成 IDR 的预测亚细胞定位和转录活性，并使不同生物功能相关的特征能够在单个序列中组合。因此，IDiom 和 RL-SAE 通过显式控制功能相关序列特征，实现了可解释且可组合的 IDR 设计。更广泛地说，在可解释特征能够作为有用设计目标的其他蛋白质设计场景中，RL-SAE 也可能适用。代码见 https://github.com/rotskoff-group/idiom。
items.author_line: Jason X. Liu, Sebastian Ibarraran, Frank Hu, Soojung Yang, Xinyu A. Feng, Abigail Park, Anagha Aneesh, Lacramioara Bintu, Alexander R. Dunn, Grant M. Rotskoff

items.title: ToSCA: Total Scattering Conditioned Variational Autoencoder for Atomic Structure Prediction from Pair Distribution Function Data
items.abstract_or_text: Designing new materials is often slow and experimentally intensive, with structural characterization representing a particular bottleneck. Recent advances in machine learning (ML) aim to accelerate this process by predicting plausible atomic structures describing a material directly from experimental data. Here we present the total scattering conditioned variational autoencoder (ToSCA), a generative ML model for predicting plausible atomic structures of metal oxide nanomaterials from total scattering and pair distribution function (PDF) data. ToSCA learns a chemically meaningful latent representation and predicts unit cells within tolerances suitable for subsequent real-space refinement. The model also shows behavior consistent with learning structural relationships between related crystal types, and can correctly place the new CHILI-Interpolation dataset in the latent space. Finally, we demonstrate that ToSCA is able to retain useful performance in a realistic use-case by testing it on 11 experimental PDFs from 3 crystal types, including test cases outside of the training distribution.
items.summary_zh: ToSCA 从 total scattering 和 pair distribution function 数据生成金属氧化物纳米材料的候选原子结构，并在训练分布外的实验 PDF 上进行测试。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它直接把实验散射数据连接到可供 real-space refinement 的结构候选，展示了对三类晶体的11个实验 PDF 的实际适用性。样本和材料类型仍较有限，生成的是 plausible structures 而非唯一结构解。
items.abstract_zh: 新材料设计往往缓慢且实验密集，其中结构表征尤其构成瓶颈。机器学习的最新进展旨在直接从实验数据预测描述材料的合理原子结构。我们提出 total scattering conditioned variational autoencoder（ToSCA），一种从 total scattering 和 pair distribution function（PDF）数据预测金属氧化物纳米材料合理原子结构的生成式机器学习模型。ToSCA 学习具有化学意义的潜在表示，并预测晶胞，其精度范围适合后续 real-space refinement。该模型还表现出与学习相关晶体类型之间结构关系一致的行为，并能将新的 CHILI-Interpolation 数据集正确置于潜在空间中。最后，我们在来自3种晶体类型的11个实验 PDF 上测试 ToSCA，包括训练分布之外的测试案例，证明它在真实使用场景中仍能保持有用性能。
items.author_line: Ulrik Friis-Jensen, Frederik L. Johansen, Erik B. Dam, Raghavendra Selvan, Kirsten M. Ø. Jensen

items.title: Neural Kinetics: LEARNING KINETICS AS TRANSPORT IN COMPOSITIONAL SPACE
items.abstract_or_text: Complex bio-derived and fossil mixtures contain thousands of molecules whose individual structures and reaction pathways cannot be fully resolved, making conventional mechanism-based kinetic modelling impractical. A reaction network detailed enough to describe every formula-level transformation would contain far more reactions and parameters than the available data can constrain. We propose to overcome this limitation by representing mixtures directly as abundance fields on a compositional grid indexed by molecular descriptors, specifically carbon number (#C) and double-bond equivalent (DBE), and by learning a time-conditioned, chemistry-informed operator that maps the initial composition to predict a later state. The evolution rates of the chemical space are learned by a two-dimensional Fourier neural operator (FNO) acting jointly on a set of heteroatom classes, with normalized time and compositional coordinates appended as input channels. Because experimental data are limited, we enlarge the training set with synthetic trajectories generated from the measured samples, pre-train on this ensemble, and then calibrate a small subset of parameters on the measured distributions. We tested the framework on a case of oxidation of a complex hydrocarbon mixture that is tracked by FTICR-MS over sixty seconds of reaction. On an independent sample the framework, that we named NeuralKinetics, reproduced the measured endpoint class composition within a mean absolute error of approximately one percent and arranged the heteroatom classes correctly on the compositional grid. The second test was an entirely different system: litter decomposition in a peatland warming experiment, also followed by FTICR-MS but over two years. The developed operator accurately predicted the endpoint class composition of the held-out sample proving that the framework is flexible enough to adapt to diverse reactive systems.
items.summary_zh: NeuralKinetics 将复杂混合物表示为按碳数和 DBE 索引的组成空间丰度场，用 Fourier neural operator 学习随时间演化的化学空间，并在氧化反应和 peatland 分解数据上预测端点组成。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 方法绕开了无法由有限数据约束的超大反应网络，在独立样本上把端点类别组成误差降至约1%，并跨越秒级氧化与两年分解体系。其适用性依赖组成描述和有限的端点观测，机理可解释性仍有限。
items.abstract_zh: 复杂的生物来源和化石来源混合物包含数千种分子，无法完全解析每个分子的结构和反应路径，因此传统的基于机理的动力学建模并不实际。若构建足够详细、能够描述每个分子式层面转化的反应网络，所需反应和参数数量将远远超过可由现有数据约束的范围。我们提出一种解决方案：将混合物直接表示为组成网格上的丰度场，该网格按分子描述符索引，具体为碳数（#C）和双键当量（DBE），并学习一个以时间为条件、具有化学信息的算子，将初始组成映射为较晚时刻的状态。化学空间的演化速率由二维 Fourier neural operator（FNO）学习；该算子在一组杂原子类别上联合运行，并将归一化时间和组成坐标作为输入通道。由于实验数据有限，我们利用从测量样本生成的合成轨迹扩充训练集，在这一集合上预训练，再用测量分布校准少量参数。我们在一个复杂烃类混合物氧化案例上测试该框架；该反应通过 FTICR-MS 追踪60秒。在独立样本上，我们命名为 NeuralKinetics 的框架以约1%的平均绝对误差重现了测量得到的端点类别组成，并正确地在组成网格上排列了杂原子类别。第二个测试是完全不同的体系：泥炭地增温实验中的凋落物分解，同样由 FTICR-MS 追踪，但持续两年。该算子准确预测了留出样本的端点类别组成，证明框架足够灵活，能够适应多种反应体系。
items.author_line: Paolo Guida, Naydu Zambrano Urrutia, Elia Colleoni, Shekhar R Kulkarni, Kevin Van Geem, William L. Roberts

items.title: Novel Quinoxaline-Based Cyanocarbonimidodithioate Derivatives as Non-Hydroxamate Selective HDAC8 Inhibitors: Design, Synthesis, Biological Evaluation and Mechanistic Studies
items.abstract_or_text: Histone deacetylase 8 (HDAC8) has emerged as a promising anticancer target; however, most clinically approved hydroxamate-based HDAC inhibitors possess several limitations. A novel series of quinoxaline-based HDAC inhibitors containing a sulfur-based cyanocarbonimidodithioate non-hydroxamate zinc-binding group was designed and synthesized to overcome the selectivity and toxicity limitations of conventional hydroxamate HDAC inhibitors. A total of twenty-three quinoxaline-cyanocarbonimidodithioate derivatives (QZ 1-23) were synthesized and evaluated for HDAC8 inhibitory activity. The compounds demonstrated preferential inhibition of HDAC8 over HDAC4. Among the series, QZ-11 (IC50 = 0.3 μM) and QZ-4 (IC50 = 0.57 μM) emerged as the most promising inhibitors exhibiting favourable selectivity profiles against other tested HDAC isoforms. Both compounds demonstrated moderate to good antiproliferative activity against the IMR-32, SH-SY5Y, and FaDu cell lines. Biological studies revealed that QZ-4 and QZ-11 significantly suppressed colony formation, induced apoptosis, activated caspase-3/7, and induced G2/M phase cell-cycle arrest in IMR-32 cells, and increased acetylation of the HDAC8 substrate SMC3 without altering total SMC3 expression. Molecular docking studies suggested key interactions with HDAC8 selectivity-determining residues His142, Tyr306, and Phe152, while molecular dynamics simulations revealed stable occupancy of the catalytic pocket and persistent Zn-associated interactions throughout 100 ns trajectories. Collectively, these findings identify quinoxaline-cyanocarbonimidodithioates as a promising class of non-hydroxamate HDAC8- inhibitors and support further optimization of sulfur-based zinc-binding pharmacophores for the development of next-generation epigenetic anticancer agents.
items.summary_zh: 研究合成23种 quinoxaline-cyanocarbonimidodithioate 化合物，筛得选择性 HDAC8 抑制剂 QZ-11 和 QZ-4，并通过细胞实验、底物乙酰化、对接和100 ns 分子动力学分析其机制。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作把非 hydroxamate 锌结合基团、异构体选择性和细胞表型连起来，QZ-11 的 IC50 = 0.3 μM 且有多层生物学验证。当前仍属早期先导化合物研究，体内药代和安全性未提供。
items.abstract_zh: 组蛋白去乙酰化酶8（HDAC8）已成为有前景的抗癌靶点；然而，大多数已获临床批准的 hydroxamate 类 HDAC 抑制剂具有若干局限。为克服传统 hydroxamate HDAC 抑制剂在选择性和毒性方面的限制，我们设计并合成了一系列 quinoxaline 类 HDAC 抑制剂，其中含有基于硫的 cyanocarbonimidodithioate 非 hydroxamate 锌结合基团。共合成23种 quinoxaline-cyanocarbonimidodithioate 衍生物（QZ 1-23），并评价其 HDAC8 抑制活性。与 HDAC4 相比，这些化合物表现出对 HDAC8 的优先抑制。在该系列中，QZ-11（IC50 = 0.3 μM）和 QZ-4（IC50 = 0.57 μM）最具潜力，并对其他测试 HDAC 亚型表现出有利的选择性。两种化合物对 IMR-32、SH-SY5Y 和 FaDu 细胞系均表现出中等至良好的抗增殖活性。生物学研究显示，QZ-4 和 QZ-11 显著抑制 IMR-32 细胞的克隆形成，诱导凋亡、激活 caspase-3/7 并引起 G2/M 期细胞周期阻滞，同时增加 HDAC8 底物 SMC3 的乙酰化，而不改变 SMC3 总表达量。分子对接提示其与 HDAC8 选择性决定残基 His142、Tyr306 和 Phe152 存在关键相互作用；分子动力学模拟则显示，在100 ns 轨迹中，化合物稳定占据催化口袋，并持续保持与 Zn 相关的相互作用。总体而言，这些结果确定了 quinoxaline-cyanocarbonimidodithioate 作为一类有前景的非 hydroxamate HDAC8 抑制剂，并支持进一步优化含硫锌结合药效团，以开发下一代表观遗传抗癌药物。
items.author_line: Kosana Sai Chaitanya, Dharani Sen, Markus Schweipert, Srinuvasu Nakka, Muzaffar-Ur-Rehman Mohammed, Katja Ohlemüller, Koshankan Chandra, Vivek Sharma, Sankaranarayanan Murugesan, Franz-Josef Meyer-Almes, Kondapalli Venkata Gowri Chandra Sekhar, KVG Chandrasekhar

items.title: Multi-Scale Temporal Flows for Peptide Trajectory Generation
items.abstract_or_text: Peptides occupy a particularly challenging regime of biomolecular dynamics. Short peptides lack a stable folded core and populate broad conformational ensembles, while cyclization adds ring closure, non-local residue coupling, and stereochemical diversity. Deep generative models have made remarkable progress in emulating molecular-dynamics trajectories directly, yet each is trained on windows cut at a fixed interval and therefore observes the process at a fixed temporal resolution. More fundamentally, none takes that interval as an input, so the physical time a window spans is never represented, leaving the sparse frames on which a peptide crosses between metastable states difficult to learn. Here, we introduce PepTIDE, a multi-scale temporal framework for peptide trajectory generation. The stride of each training window is drawn from a continuous range, so one model observes the same dynamics at many temporal resolutions, and an Adaptive Physical-Time Embedding encodes the relative interval of a window together with the absolute time of each frame, making the shared velocity field interval-aware. All frames are generated jointly through a stochastic-interpolant flow, and pair-aware invariant point attention captures the geometry and topology of both linear and cyclic peptides. On PepMD and a 50-system cyclic-peptide benchmark, PepTIDE reaches state-of-the-art distribution agreement and structural validity. Read in temporal order, its trajectories recover these sparse transition frames and reproduce inter-state fluxes more faithfully, confirming that modeling multiple temporal scales is what makes these rare events accessible.
items.summary_zh: PepTIDE 让训练窗口跨连续时间步长，并用 Adaptive Physical-Time Embedding 和 pair-aware invariant point attention 生成线性及环状肽的多尺度动力学轨迹。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在 PepMD 和50个 cyclic-peptide 系统上达到 state-of-the-art 分布一致性和结构有效性，并更好重现稀疏转变态和状态间通量。证据来自模拟基准，尚无与实验动力学的直接对照。
items.abstract_zh: 肽处于生物分子动力学中尤其具有挑战性的区域。短肽缺乏稳定的折叠核心，会占据广泛的构象集合；而环化又增加了闭环、非局部残基耦合和立体化学多样性。深度生成模型在直接模拟分子动力学轨迹方面取得了显著进展，但每个模型都在固定间隔截取的窗口上训练，因此只能以固定时间分辨率观察过程。更根本的是，现有模型都不把该间隔作为输入，所以窗口覆盖的物理时间从未被表示；这使得模型难以学习肽跨越亚稳态之间的稀疏帧。我们提出 PepTIDE，一种用于肽轨迹生成的多尺度时间框架。每个训练窗口的步长从连续范围中抽取，使一个模型能够以多种时间分辨率观察同一动力学；Adaptive Physical-Time Embedding 则编码窗口的相对间隔以及每一帧的绝对时间，使共享速度场具有间隔感知能力。所有帧都通过随机插值流联合生成，而 pair-aware invariant point attention 捕捉线性肽和环状肽的几何与拓扑。在 PepMD 和一个包含50个系统的 cyclic-peptide 基准上，PepTIDE 达到 state-of-the-art 的分布一致性和结构有效性。按时间顺序读取时，其轨迹能够恢复这些稀疏的转变态，并更忠实地重现状态间通量，证实多时间尺度建模是使这些稀有事件可学习的关键。
items.author_line: Xichen Sun, Wentao Wei, Xiaoxi Zhang, Yuedong Yang, Jiahua Rao

items.title: Auditable Algebraic Counting Field for Cryptic-Pocket Detection from Apo Structures
items.abstract_or_text: Cryptic ligand-binding pockets are not apparent in experimentally determined apo structures, making them difficult to identify from unbound receptor geometry. A complementary challenge is to make the structural measurements and learned evidence behind each prediction directly inspectable. We introduce a supervised algebraic counting field (ACF) for predicting cryptic-pocket residues from apo structures. ACF compiles explicit geometric, physicochemical, and topological features into compact, integer-weighted lookup tables. Each prediction score can be reconstructed from feature values, training counts, table weights, and spatial aggregation, without sequence search, structural-template transfer, or a protein language model at inference. We evaluate ACF on CryptoBench and two locked external collections, separating ranking performance from the effects of residue-calling budgets. On an external set of 57 post-CryptoBench apo-holo units, ACF exceeded P2Rank by +0.044 in mean paired ROC-AUC (multiplicity-adjusted 95% CI [+0.010, +0.079]). The advantage was dataset-dependent: official-fold ROC-AUC and matched-budget F1 differences against P2Rank remained unresolved, and a second external evaluation did not confirm gains from added structural features. ACF thus provides a compact predictor with externally validated signal and an inspectable path from structural measurements and training counts to residue scores.
items.summary_zh: ACF 用显式几何、物理化学和拓扑特征构建可审计的整数加权查找表，从 apo 结构预测 cryptic-pocket 残基，并在外部57个 apo-holo 单元上与 P2Rank 比较。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 模型不依赖序列搜索、结构模板或蛋白语言模型，预测分数可逐项重构；外部集合 ROC-AUC 提升 +0.044 且给出置信区间。优势具有数据集依赖性，官方折叠和第二外部评估未稳定确认全部增益。
items.abstract_zh: 隐蔽的配体结合口袋在实验获得的 apo 结构中并不明显，因此难以从未结合受体的几何结构中识别。另一个互补挑战是，使预测背后的结构测量和学习证据可以直接检查。我们提出 supervised algebraic counting field（ACF），用于从 apo 结构预测 cryptic-pocket 残基。ACF 将明确的几何、物理化学和拓扑特征编译为紧凑的整数加权查找表。每个预测分数都可以根据特征值、训练计数、表权重和空间聚合过程重构，无需在推理时进行序列搜索、结构模板迁移或使用蛋白质语言模型。我们在 CryptoBench 和两个锁定的外部集合上评估 ACF，并区分排序性能与残基调用预算的影响。在一个包含57个 CryptoBench 之后 apo-holo 单元的外部集合上，ACF 的平均配对 ROC-AUC 比 P2Rank 高 +0.044（经多重性调整的95% CI 为 [+0.010, +0.079]）。这一优势依赖于数据集：在官方折叠 ROC-AUC 和匹配预算 F1 方面，相对于 P2Rank 的差异仍未得到解决，而第二次外部评估也未确认增加结构特征所带来的增益。因此，ACF 提供了一个紧凑的预测器，具有经过外部验证的信号，并能从结构测量和训练计数到残基分数提供可检查的路径。

items.title: pCoMole: Pareto-Constrained Molecule Editing with Discrete Flows
items.abstract_or_text: Biomolecular therapeutics often start from known sequences and require targeted editing to improve multiple properties while satisfying hard biochemical and manufacturability constraints. However, existing generative methods do not jointly support multi-objective optimization, hard feasibility, and sequence editing in discrete, variable-length biological spaces. In this work, we introduce Pareto-Constrained Molecule Editing (pCoMole), a framework built on discrete flow matching that steers a pre-trained Edit Flow toward user-specified preferences while enforcing terminal feasibility. pCoMole defines a feasibility-gated terminal distribution using an augmented Tchebycheff utility and realizes the resulting preference tilt through a Doob-h transform of the underlying edit process. To make this construction practical, we approximate the required harmonic function using short Monte Carlo rollouts over candidate edits, yielding an efficient guided editor with provable preference consistency. We validate pCoMole by shrinking GFP while retaining fluorescence-related properties, shortening diverse Cas9 orthologs while preserving PAM specificity, and compressing peptide binders into short peptidomimetics that optimize seven drug-related properties under hard constraints. In wet lab testing, two 229-residue pCoMole-designed eGFP variants retained clear green fluorescence in BL21 cells after 10 deletions, with either one or two substitutions. Together, pCoMole enables constraint-aware, Pareto-aligned editing of biomolecular sequences in discrete, variable-length spaces.
items.summary_zh: pCoMole 基于离散 flow matching，在硬可行性约束下按 Pareto 偏好编辑可变长度生物分子序列，并验证 GFP、Cas9 和 peptide binders 的多目标压缩。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 框架同时处理多目标优化、终端可行性和序列编辑，并对两个 eGFP 变体进行了湿实验验证；但湿实验规模很小，Cas9 和 peptide binder 结果主要仍是计算评估。
items.abstract_zh: 生物分子治疗药物通常从已知序列开始，需要有针对性地编辑，以改善多种性质，同时满足严格的生化和可制造性约束。然而，现有生成方法不能在离散、可变长度的生物空间中同时支持多目标优化、硬可行性和序列编辑。在本研究中，我们提出 Pareto-Constrained Molecule Editing（pCoMole），一种建立在离散 flow matching 上的框架：它引导预训练的 Edit Flow 满足用户指定的偏好，同时强制终端可行性。pCoMole 使用增广 Tchebycheff utility 定义可行性门控的终端分布，并通过底层编辑过程的 Doob-h 变换实现所需的偏好倾斜。为使这一构造具有实用性，我们利用候选编辑上的短程 Monte Carlo rollouts 近似所需的调和函数，从而得到具有可证明偏好一致性的高效引导编辑器。我们通过缩短 GFP 同时保留荧光相关性质、缩短多种 Cas9 orthologs 同时保持 PAM 特异性，以及将 peptide binders 压缩为在硬约束下优化七种药物相关性质的短 peptidomimetics，对 pCoMole 进行了验证。在湿实验中，两个由 pCoMole 设计的229-residue eGFP 变体，在删除10个残基并带有一个或两个替换后，于 BL21 细胞中仍保留清晰的绿色荧光。总之，pCoMole 能够在离散、可变长度空间中实现具有约束感知、Pareto 对齐的生物分子序列编辑。
items.author_line: Tong Chen, Maximilian Holsman, Lin Zhao, Pranam Chatterjee

items.title: SupraTITO: Transferable Generative Molecular Dynamics for Supramolecular Systems
items.abstract_or_text: Peptide sequence governs both the structures formed through supramolecular assembly and the dynamics by which they emerge, but predicting either requires resolving slow collective processes among many interacting molecules. Molecular dynamics (MD) provides microscopic insight into these processes, yet the long timescales of assembly and the vast peptide sequence space make systematic exploration computationally demanding. We introduce SupraTITO, a transferable generative molecular dynamics (GenMD) framework for supramolecular systems, demonstrated through peptide self-assembly. SupraTITO learns transferable implicit transfer operators (TITO) conditioned on peptide sequence, molecular topology, and periodic geometry, allowing configurations to be propagated over physical intervals much longer than an MD integration step. On a comprehensive dipeptide benchmark, SupraTITO generalizes to held-out sequences and reproduces sequence-dependent structures and dynamics while maintaining molecular integrity over long rollouts. Compared with direct ensemble prediction trained on the same trajectory data, SupraTITO more accurately reproduces assembly structures while also resolving their temporal evolution. The learned dynamics generalize across peptide concentrations, including dilute conditions not represented during training. These results extend transferable GenMD to collective dynamics in periodic supramolecular systems and provide a foundation for modeling related processes beyond peptide assembly.
items.summary_zh: SupraTITO 学习以肽序列、分子拓扑和周期几何为条件的可迁移隐式转移算子，用较长物理时间间隔推进肽自组装动力学。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在留出序列和不同浓度上同时重现组装结构与时间演化，长时间 rollout 仍保持分子完整性，为大规模肽自组装探索提供了加速路径。当前验证集中于 dipeptide 基准。
items.abstract_zh: 肽序列决定超分子组装形成的结构以及其形成动力学，但预测两者都需要解析许多相互作用分子之间缓慢的集体过程。分子动力学（MD）能够提供这些过程的微观信息，但组装的长时间尺度和庞大的肽序列空间使系统探索在计算上十分昂贵。我们提出 SupraTITO，一种可迁移的超分子体系生成式分子动力学（GenMD）框架，并以肽自组装为例进行展示。SupraTITO 学习以肽序列、分子拓扑和周期几何为条件的可迁移隐式转移算子（TITO），能够以远长于 MD 积分步长的物理时间间隔推进构型。在一个综合 dipeptide 基准上，SupraTITO 泛化到留出序列，在长时间 rollout 中重现依赖序列的结构和动力学，同时保持分子完整性。与使用相同轨迹数据训练的直接集合预测相比，SupraTITO 更准确地重现组装结构，同时还能解析其时间演化。学习到的动力学还能跨越肽浓度泛化，包括训练中未出现的稀释条件。这些结果将可迁移 GenMD 扩展到周期超分子体系中的集体动力学，并为模拟肽自组装之外的相关过程奠定基础。
items.author_line: Weilong Chen, Nuno Costa, Julija Zavadlav

items.title: Can LLMs Reliably Annotate Bioassay Metadata to Improve Data Readiness?
items.abstract_or_text: The emergence of foundation models for molecular property prediction requires a high degree of AI data readiness, including reliable metadata annotation. However, both public repositories and industrial screening databases suffer from missing, inconsistent, or conflated assay annotations. In this work, we quantify the extent of missing annotations in PubChem for the BioAssay Ontology (BAO) assay format and physical detection method fields and investigate whether open-source and proprietary large language models (LLMs) can reliably predict and audit metadata annotations directly from the assay text. In our assessment, we found that the annotation coverage across PubChem's \sim2 million bioassays is critically sparse, 36\% lacking an assay format, 89\% a BioAssay type, and >99.9\% any BAO-mapped assay format or detection technology term. This motivates the need for automated test-metadata curation. Using evaluation sets derived from PubChem and ChEMBL, we assess the agreement of seven open-source and proprietary LLMs with existing silver labels. Recall is at least 0.96 for biochemical and cell-based assay formats, with a similar pattern for detection technology, although disagreements increase on under-represented classes. Manual inspection shows that many of these disagreements trace back to inconsistencies between silver sources rather than to LLM error. Moreover, in a qualitative study with a senior industrial curator, LLM-generated evidence prompted the expert to revise some of their own labels, showing LLMs can flag potentially mislabeled assays. Across the study, performance differences between proprietary and open-source models were small. Together, these results suggest LLMs can support the large-scale annotation and auditing of assay metadata, though per-class reliability estimates and targeted human review remain necessary before such labels enter downstream ML pipelines.
items.summary_zh: 研究评估 PubChem 约2 million 个 bioassays 的 BAO 元数据缺失程度，并测试七种 LLM 从 assay 文本预测和审计 assay format 与 detection technology 标注的能力。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 结果揭示下游分子学习数据准备中的系统性缺口，LLM 在 biochemical 和 cell-based assay format 上 recall 至少0.96，并能促使资深标注者修正标签。少数类别和银标准不一致仍需要逐类可靠性估计及人工复核。
items.abstract_zh: 分子性质预测基础模型的出现要求高度的 AI 数据准备度，包括可靠的元数据标注。然而，公共数据库和工业筛选数据库都存在 assay 标注缺失、不一致或混淆的问题。在本研究中，我们量化 PubChem 中 BioAssay Ontology（BAO） assay format 字段和 physical detection method 字段的缺失程度，并研究开源及专有大型语言模型（LLM）能否直接从 assay 文本可靠地预测和审计元数据标注。我们的评估发现，在 PubChem 约2 million 个 bioassays 中，36% 缺少 assay format，89% 缺少 BioAssay type，超过99.9% 缺少任何 BAO 映射的 assay format 或 detection technology 术语。这凸显了自动化 assay 元数据整理的必要性。我们使用从 PubChem 和 ChEMBL 得到的评估集，评估七个开源及专有 LLM 与现有银标准标签的一致性。对于 biochemical 和 cell-based assay format，recall 至少为0.96；detection technology 也呈现相似模式，但在代表性不足的类别上分歧增加。人工检查显示，许多分歧源于银标准之间的不一致，而不是 LLM 错误。此外，在一项与资深工业标注者开展的定性研究中，LLM 生成的证据促使专家修改了部分自身标签，表明 LLM 可以标记潜在的错误 assay。总体而言，LLM 可以支持大规模 assay 元数据标注和审计，但在这些标签进入下游机器学习流程之前，仍需要逐类可靠性估计和有针对性的人工复核。
items.author_line: Laura van Weesep, Riccardo Tedoldi, Jens Sjölund, Hossein Azizpour, Susanne Winiwarter, Ola Engkvist, Jon Paul Janet, Samuel Genheden, Juan Viguera Diez

items.title: Assessing the state of the art in ADMET prediction: Lessons from the OpenADMET-ExpansionRx community blind challenge
items.abstract_or_text: Computational blind challenges are essential for advancing drug discovery, especially in research areas with limited public data, such as absorption, distribution, metabolism, excretion, toxicity (ADMET) prediction. In this paper, we present the results of our latest community blind challenge, organized in collaboration with Expansion Therapeutics (ExpansionRx). Participants were tasked with predicting nine distinct ADMET endpoints routinely evaluated during lead optimization of compounds in drug discovery programs. Following unprecedented engagement from the global community, this challenge provided valuable insights into the state of the art in machine learning for ADMET modeling. Evaluating submissions against a realistic, challenging dataset from active ExpansionRx drug discovery programs revealed that message-passing neural networks and chemical foundation models dominated among the top performers. Furthermore, the results highlighted the power of proprietary industry datasets and a critical need to optimize predictive workflows for different endpoints independently via multitasking and task-affinity grouping. We also demonstrate how hosting our open-source blind challenge infrastructure on a flexible platform like Hugging Face was pivotal for driving community engagement and visibility. Ultimately, blind challenges supported by robust infrastructure, widespread dissemination, and rigorous post-challenge analysis are fundamental to maximizing the utility of public data releases. We anticipate that these community benchmarks will continue to drive the advancement of ADMET models, enabling their deployment in both early- and late-stage drug discovery.
items.summary_zh: OpenADMET-ExpansionRx 社区盲测比较九项 ADMET 终点的模型表现，发现 message-passing neural networks 和 chemical foundation models 领先，并强调按终点进行多任务和任务亲和分组。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 数据来自真实药物发现项目而非公开训练集，盲测为 ADMET 模型的外部可比性提供了较强证据。结果也提示专有数据和终点定制流程的重要性，不能简单外推为所有 ADMET 任务的统一最优方案。
items.abstract_zh: 计算盲测对于推动药物发现尤其重要，因为吸收、分布、代谢、排泄和毒性（ADMET）预测等研究领域的公开数据有限。在本文中，我们介绍最新一次社区盲测的结果，该挑战与 Expansion Therapeutics（ExpansionRx）合作组织。参与者需要预测药物发现项目先导优化阶段常规评估的九个不同 ADMET 终点。全球社区的参与度前所未有；在来自 ExpansionRx 正在进行的药物发现项目、具有现实性且富有挑战性的数据集上评估提交结果后，我们获得了关于机器学习 ADMET 建模 state of the art 的重要认识。结果显示，排名靠前的模型主要是 message-passing neural networks 和 chemical foundation models。此外，结果突出了专有行业数据的作用，以及针对不同终点分别优化预测流程的关键必要性，包括使用多任务学习和 task-affinity grouping。我们还展示了，将开源盲测基础设施托管在 Hugging Face 等灵活平台上，对于促进社区参与和提升可见度至关重要。总之，由稳健基础设施支持、广泛传播并配合严格事后分析的盲测，对于最大化公开数据发布的实用价值至关重要。我们预计，这类社区基准将继续推动 ADMET 模型发展，支持其部署到药物发现的早期和后期阶段。

items.title: Agentic Paper: From Tacit Expertise to AI-Ready Scientific Data and Knowledge Corpora
items.abstract_or_text: Artificial intelligence (AI) for domain science demands large, well-structured training corpora that integrate experimental data with not only explicit knowledge but also tacit expertise underlying scientific decisions. However, the tacit knowledge regarding practical reasoning, assumptions, failed attempts, parameter choices, and interpretive judgment is often held by authors and unpublished, hindering its use for AI development. Here, we propose Agentic Paper, a large language model (LLM)-enabled, author-curated scientific publishing framework that organizes these resources into a structured Agentic Paper package accessible through LLM-based interfaces, enabling the integration of connected, AI-ready data, explicit knowledge, and tacit expertise. Within Agentic Paper, the LLM serves as an interactive reasoning and orchestration layer that connects knowledge content with raw and processed data, figures, methodological details, metadata, code, and author-provided interpretation. Case studies in materials synthesis and characterization demonstrate how the LLM-enabled framework supports questioning, data visualization and inspection, numerical verification, and preparation of AI-ready datasets. By combining author-based organization of scientific data and knowledge, Agentic Paper provides a scalable pathway toward provenance-rich training corpora and more reliable AI-enabled scientific workflows.
items.summary_zh: Agentic Paper 提出由作者整理、LLM 编排的科学出版包，把原始和处理后数据、方法、代码、元数据及隐性实验判断组织成可查询的 AI-ready 语料。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它针对训练语料中缺失的 tacit expertise 和 provenance，案例展示了问答、可视化、数值核验和数据集准备。当前证据是材料合成与表征案例，标准化成本和长期维护尚待验证。
items.abstract_zh: 面向领域科学的人工智能（AI）需要大规模、结构良好的训练语料，这些语料不仅整合实验数据和显式知识，也要整合支撑科学决策的隐性专业知识。然而，关于实践推理、假设、失败尝试、参数选择和解释判断的隐性知识通常掌握在作者手中且未被发表，阻碍了其用于 AI 开发。在此，我们提出 Agentic Paper，一种由大型语言模型（LLM）支持、由作者整理的科学出版框架，将这些资源组织成结构化的 Agentic Paper package，并通过基于 LLM 的接口访问，从而整合彼此连接的 AI-ready 数据、显式知识和隐性专业知识。在 Agentic Paper 中，LLM 充当交互式推理与编排层，将知识内容与原始及处理后数据、图表、方法细节、元数据、代码和作者提供的解释连接起来。材料合成与表征案例研究表明，该 LLM 支持的框架能够进行提问、数据可视化与检查、数值核验以及 AI-ready 数据集准备。通过结合基于作者的科学数据和知识组织方式，Agentic Paper 为构建具有来源信息的训练语料以及更可靠的 AI 科学工作流提供了一条可扩展路径。
items.author_line: Luke Schneider, Ganesh Narasimha, Sumner B. Harris, Ralph Bulanadi, Asraful Haque, Rama Vasudevan, Jiawei Gong, Yongtao Liu

items.title: Excited-State Intramolecular Proton Transfer Dynamics with Neural Network Potentials and Nuclear Quantum Effects
items.abstract_or_text: Excited-state intramolecular proton transfer is a prototypical ultrafast process that forms the foundation for many chemical and biological phenomena and is highly sensitive to changes in the underlying potential energy landscape. Here, we develop neural network potentials for 10-hydroxybenzo[h]quinoline that describe ground- and excited-state dynamics with near ab initio accuracy. These neural network potentials enable efficient sampling of the proton transfer coordinate and incorporation of nuclear quantum effects through path-integral molecular dynamics. The free energy profiles show that excited-state intramolecular proton transfer proceeds on a largely barrierless excited-state surface, with nuclear quantum effects reducing and smoothing the residual barrier. Non-equilibrium simulations yield an average proton transfer time of ~11.5 fs for quantum hydrogen, consistent with experiment, and reveal a clear isotope effect, with slower dynamics for deuterium and classical nuclei. Mechanistic analysis identifies transient proton donor–acceptor contraction as the key enabling coordinate, while the proton crosses the midpoint prior to reaching the minimum of this coordinate, indicating a dynamically driven transfer. Subtle changes in the conjugated backbone precede proton transfer, reflecting early electronic reorganization and coherent coupling between proton motion and backbone vibrations. Bond-length alternation and vibrational coherence analysis reveal isotope-dependent coherence loss, with deuteration producing stronger damping and more localized proton/backbone dynamics relative to hydrogen. These results establish neural network potential-based approaches as an effective framework for simulating excited-state proton transfer with explicit nuclear quantum effects.
items.summary_zh: 研究为 10-hydroxybenzo[h]quinoline 构建近似 ab initio 的基态和激发态神经网络势，并结合 path-integral molecular dynamics 解析质子转移和同位素效应。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 模拟给出约11.5 fs 的量子氢转移时间并与实验一致，进一步揭示供体-受体收缩、骨架电子重组和振动相干的动力学机制。验证对象是单一分子，模型跨体系泛化仍未知。
items.abstract_zh: 激发态分子内质子转移是一种典型的超快过程，是许多化学和生物现象的基础，并且对潜在能量面的变化高度敏感。在此，我们为 10-hydroxybenzo[h]quinoline 开发了神经网络势，能够以接近 ab initio 的精度描述基态和激发态动力学。这些神经网络势支持对质子转移坐标进行高效采样，并通过 path-integral molecular dynamics 纳入核量子效应。自由能剖面显示，激发态分子内质子转移在很大程度上沿无势垒的激发态表面进行，而核量子效应会降低并平滑剩余势垒。非平衡模拟得到量子氢的平均质子转移时间约为11.5 fs，与实验一致；同时揭示出明显的同位素效应：氘和经典原子核的动力学比氢更慢。机制分析确定，瞬态的质子供体-受体收缩是转移的关键促进坐标；质子在该坐标达到最小值之前就越过中点，说明该转移由动力学驱动。共轭骨架的细微变化先于质子转移发生，反映出早期电子重组以及质子运动与骨架振动之间的相干耦合。键长交替和振动相干分析揭示了依赖同位素的相干性损失：与氢相比，氘化会产生更强的阻尼以及更局域化的质子/骨架动力学。这些结果表明，基于神经网络势的方法是模拟具有显式核量子效应的激发态质子转移的有效框架。
items.author_line: Axel Gomez, Amke Nimmrich, Victor M. Freixas, Chenghao Zhang, Shaul Mukamel, Munira Khalil, Niranjan Govind
